Naghachu's Yuan remnant in Manchuria (Liaoyang), surrendered to the Ming by 1387 (Yuan dynasty page)

problems: Page budget exceeded: 5 pages opened against 1-2 for a 3-shape state, because the 1363 Cliopatria shape drops Korea, Tibet and the south and needed Phagmodrupa dynasty and Gongmin of Goryeo to explain it, and List of Yuan emperors for the ruler strip.
The Yuan is drawn 1294-1368, not Cliopatria's 1294-1374: northern-yuan (begins September 1368) and the Ming take the land; yuan-dynasty_1363 is bounded to 1368.

Cliopatria rows 'Great Yuan' (Dayuan, Ferghana, -110..50) and 'Great Mongol State' (Bogd Khanate, 1912-1925) share Wikidata Q7313 with 'Yuan Dynasty' but are different states; only 'Yuan Dynasty' is in cliopatria_names (great-yuan and great-mongol-state dossiers already say so).

Rows whose gains name yuan-dynasty as counterpart in other dossiers (tianwan, zhang-shicheng-s-wu, zhu-yuanzhang-s-wu, han-song, fang-guozhen-s-regime, goryeo, tibet, principality-of-liang-yunnan, northern-yuan) are mirrored as losses here; where my page dates differ from theirs (Hanyang 1356 vs January 1355; Gaoyou 1353 vs 1354; Dongnyeong 1356 vs 1290) the notes say so.
